Africa's Richest Man Launches Kenya Oil Refinery

Alhaji Aliko Dangote, described as Africa's richest man, has launched an oil refinery in Kenya. The refinery is part of a larger plan to industrialize Africa by 2030. The project involves a $300 million deal with US firm Honeywell and has a capacity for 700,000 barrels a day. The refinery's launch proceeded despite land protests.
